visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a bright living room featuring white curtains and simple wooden furniture. A young woman with short black hair, wearing a white sleeveless dress with a floral pattern, jumps energetically into the frame from the side. She holds a silver smartphone and points toward it with an excited, wide-eyed facial expression. White comic-style speed line overlays burst from the center to emphasize her sudden appearance. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the woman's hands holding the smartphone. The screen displays the ChatGPT mobile app interface with text bubbles and an animated circular icon at the bottom. The background remains the soft-focus interior of the room. (3) The woman is back in a medium shot, looking directly at the camera. She points her finger and gestures broadly with her hands while talking animatedly. She looks surprised and intrigued, her eyebrows raised. The wooden table and plants in the background are clearly visible under bright, natural indoor lighting. (4) Another close-up of the smartphone screen shows a blue and white animated orb pulsating on the interface, indicating the AI is processing or speaking. The woman's manicured fingers are seen gripping the edges of the device. (5) The shot returns to the woman, who now wears a confused and slightly frustrated expression. She holds the phone in both hands, staring at it with narrowed eyes and a slight pout, then looks back at the camera to share her reaction. (6) A final close-up of the phone shows a different text response on the screen while the woman holds it steady. (7) The woman stands in the center of the room, holding the phone near her face like a microphone, then looks at the camera with a skeptical, humorous face, shrugging her shoulders as she finishes her story.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice speaks with high energy and rapid articulation, accompanied by a quick synthesized whoosh sound effect as she jumps in. The room tone is silent, creating a clean studio-like vocal presence. (2) A digital 'blip' UI sound triggers as the audio source shifts to a male AI voice. This voice has a neutral, calm professional tone, explaining it will sing. (3) The AI voice begins a short melodic phrase, singing 'Cheer baby' in a soft, major-key melody with synthetic smoothness. (4) The female voice returns with a conversational, inquisitive tone, questioning the AI. There is no background music, keeping focus on the dialogue. (5) The male AI voice responds with a simulated soft chuckle and a polite, slightly lower-pitched explanation that it cannot sing. (6) A hard cut leads back to the female voice, who increases her speech rate and volume, expressing mild frustration and playful persistence. (7) The male AI voice repeats its technical limitation in a consistent, non-emotional robotic manner. (8) A final phase features the male AI voice singing a nursery rhyme with a simple, bright melodic contour and clear, slightly breathy vocal delivery, followed by the female voice giving a final, high-arousal humorous commentary.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Testing copyrighted song -> Testing non-copyrighted song -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video investigates the capabilities and restrictions of ChatGPT's voice mode regarding singing. The creator humorously highlights how the AI refuses to sing copyrighted K-pop songs but agrees to sing non-copyrighted or public domain melodies, questioning the logic and consistency of the AI's behavior.
